causality_contract.availability_rule: 15m delta + volume use trades <= bar close; displacement uses bars <= close; availability_time = signal bar close

dataset_policy.allowed: certified Binance UM aggTrades day(s) + same-provenance holding data

deduplication.rule: one open position per symbol; signals while in position ignored

entry.rule: signal at 1m bar close; market fill at next bar open
entry.timing: decision_time = signal bar close; entry_time = next bar open

event_definition: 15-minute window with |delta|/volume >= 0.4 AND window volume >= 2x trailing-20-window median (exhaustion-grade one-sided flow), followed within 5 bars by opposite-direction 1m displacement (range > 2x ATR14).
execution_model: NEXT_BAR_OPEN (certified channel; SL-first ambiguity; single position)
falsification: With sufficient evidence, pooled Cost-C expectancy <= 0 falsifies (FAIL).
invalidation: Displacement fails (no opposite close) within 5 bars, or new extreme delta with the old trend.
mechanism: Exhaustion-grade one-sided flow depletes the prevailing pressure; an opposite displacement marks the reversal being accepted.
research_question: Does exhaustion-grade REAL delta followed by opposite causal displacement predict reversal?
threshold_provenance: Delta fraction 0.4 = strong one-sided participation cutoff (domain convention, fixed). Volume 2x trailing median = elevated-participation gate (frozen 11G-A pattern). Displacement 2xATR = certified 11F definition. None fitted to outcomes.
